name: SBNA - Small Business Networking Alliance

hero.alt: SBNA members at a networking lunch meeting

intro.text: SBNA is an independent, member-driven networking group of more than 20 local business owners on Long Island's North Shore. Established more than ten years ago, with many founders still active, members meet every Wednesday for a structured lunch to share expertise, spotlight each other's businesses and pass referrals. It's local, not a national franchise.

services.d: Every Wednesday, 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM, with a structured agenda.
Each profession holds a single seat, so members never compete for the same referrals.
Members share their expertise and what makes a good referral, with regular member spotlights.
Guests are welcome. Reach out first so we can confirm your profession's seat is open.

advantage.text: SBNA is led by President TJ Sirani, Vice President John McGregor and Treasurer Judi Wallace. Browse the full member directory on the SBNA website.

reviews.text: Members and guests, a quick review helps other local owners find a group that fits.

faq: Every Wednesday from 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM in the Port Jefferson area. We share exact details when you reach out.
